human_actions_pending.context: verify_auth now fails closed on a non-loopback bind, but the installed unit sets MODEL_MANAGER_ALLOW_UNAUTH=1, so the service currently runs in acknowledged-open mode and logs every unauthenticated mutation. Setting a key would close it properly.

decisions.decision: Bootstrapped .planning/ by hand instead of running /gsd-new-project
decisions.rationale: The repo had no .planning. /gsd-new-project spawns four research agents to derive context that an 18-minute Codex xhigh audit plus live verification had just established. Roadmap was written directly from verified findings.

decisions.decision: Keep nvidia_entrypoint.sh and pass `vllm serve` as the container command, rather than `docker run --entrypoint vllm`
decisions.rationale: Bypassing the entrypoint discards the image's CUDA environment setup. With vLLM down that regression class cannot be detected, and the known-good hand-written qwen3-8b profile on this box already uses the command form.

decisions.decision: verify_auth fails closed at the request layer (503), not at startup
decisions.rationale: The installed unit already carries MODEL_MANAGER_ALLOW_UNAUTH=1, so the live service keeps running and merely starts logging unauthenticated mutations, while an unconfigured deployment refuses them. A startup abort would have taken the running service down on restart.

decisions.decision: Grammar validation AND shlex.quote, not either alone
decisions.rationale: Grammar makes the injection unreachable; quoting is defence-in-depth if the grammar is ever loosened. The $HOME cache mount is deliberately exempt from quoting because it relies on launch-time shell expansion.

decisions.decision: Derived settings must be hybrid-attention-aware before anything else in Phase 2
decisions.rationale: Measured on this box: a naive num_hidden_layers KV estimate overestimates by 4-11x on every hybrid model here. A recommender without it would refuse context that is actually free.

next_action: Run /gsd-plan-phase 2 to plan the derived launch spec. The solver's shape is already validated — see the prototype at /tmp/kvcalc.py and the KV table in .continue-here.md. It produced 0.54 for qwen3-next-80b against a hand-measured 0.55, which is the calibration check to reproduce as a test.
context_notes: Phase 1 was reactive (three confirmed outages found by audit). Phase 2 is the work Josh originally asked for: context options and recommended settings. The key insight driving it is that --max-model-len is nearly free on this box's hybrid/MoE models (Qwen3.6 needs only ~2.7 GB of fp8 KV at its full 262144 context) while --gpu-memory-utilization is the real memory lever. The generator's flat 32768/0.75 defaults contradict the hand-measured recipes on both counts. Phase 2 is a pure function and fully testable with vLLM down.
